note: Carroll County OH publishes no county zoning layer; its GIS portal (carroll.countygis.org) is a parcel viewer with no zoning service and its disclaimer says it is not for zoning. Townships do not appear to zone (2006 county plan). The village of Carrollton, the county seat, publishes its zoning district map only as a PDF (villageofcarrollton.com/zoning); Malvern's site lists ordinances but no zoning GIS. No queryable zoning district polygons were found for any Carroll County jurisdiction, so the county is recorded as viewer-only (PDF maps).
